title: Block Sliding to a Stop
body: A $$4\, \text{kg}$$ block slides across a rough horizontal floor at $$7\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$. $$The$$ $$coefficient$$ $$of$$ $$kinetic$$ $$friction$$ $$between$$ $$the$$ $$block$$ $$and$$ $$floor$$ $$is$$ $$0.5$$. $$Find$$ $$how$$ $$far$$ $$the$$ $$block$$ $$slides$$ $$before$$ $$stopping$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$g=9.8\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$.
